sources.title: Houston Texans Wide Receiver Room Update
sources.description: The Houston Texans took a massive hit at wide receiver last week when promising second-year wide receiver Jayden Higgins suffered a season-ending torn ACL. General manager Nick Caserio responded quickly, adding veteran wide receivers Zay Jones and Sterling Shepard.
